changeSet.author: kmarete
changeSet.comment: Allocate public dataset aliases with a database sequence. The trigger is a rolling-deployment compatibility mechanism: it replaces aliases supplied by old application instances as well as allocating aliases for new instances that omit the column.
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE dataset IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE
SELECT setval( 'dataset_alias_seq', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(alias) FROM dataset), 0) + 1, false )
CREATE TRIGGER dataset_alias_allocate BEFORE INSERT ON dataset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION allocate_dataset_alias()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS dataset_alias_allocate ON dataset
